## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python -m pytest -q` locally.
- [ ] I ran `python -m awengine demo` when the change affects runtime behavior.
- [ ] New behavior has a regression test, or the PR explains why a test is not
      practical.
- [ ] User-facing changes are reflected in `README.md`, `MANUAL.md`, or `docs/`.
- [ ] No API keys, private code, customer data, or absolute local paths are
      included.
- [ ] Backward compatibility was considered for YAML fields, CLI flags, events,
      and exit codes.
- [ ] The change follows the layering rules in `docs/architecture.md`.
